items.headline: Tamar AI's TapNow Brings AI-Native Filmmaking to Venice Production Bridge With HappyHorse-Backed 10,000 Parallel Universes Films, Unveils Streamer Glanze
items.excerpt: TapNow, HappyHorse and Glanze head to the Venice Production Bridge as Palo Alto's Tamar AI bets its AI-native 'creative operating system' can turn small teams into global studios. The web version of streamer Glanze launched Sept. 4 with 40-plus series.

items.headline: Google DeepMind, Amazon Web Services, Kling AI Join Busan Market Tech Program InnoAsia
items.excerpt: Busan's Asian Contents & Film Market unveiled its InnoAsia lineup, pairing global AI tech firms with seven Korean startups plus a branded-film contest with Hanwha and Innocean.

items.headline: Nikola Todorovic on the latest developments in Autodesk's Flow Studio
items.excerpt: How Flow Studio's new 3D Editor + Canvas works: interactive 3D scene construction married to generative 2D video models, so prompt-based images gain real camera and blocking control.

items.headline: One of the new categories at the VES Awards is 'Outstanding In-Camera Effects in a Photoreal Project'
items.excerpt: The Visual Effects Society announced new categories and rule updates for the VES Awards, including a category that singles out effects achieved in camera rather than generated in post.

items.headline: Eddie AI Launches an Agent Marketplace of Editing Agents Built on Great Filmmakers
items.excerpt: Eddie AI's new Agent Marketplace offers editing agents modeled on the sensibilities of well-known filmmakers, letting editors run a cut past a Nolan-flavored assistant.

items.headline: You Can Now Run Eddie AI as an MCP Server, Unlocking Pay-As-You-Go Use for AI Assistant Editing
items.excerpt: Eddie AI now runs as an MCP server with pay-as-you-go pricing, so editors can drive assistant edits from inside Claude or ChatGPT instead of a separate app.

items.headline: Caira gets AI generative video editing feature
items.excerpt: Camera Intelligence's Caira camera adds Gemini Omni and Runway Aleph-powered generative editing, letting shooters relight, reframe and extend footage they have already captured.

items.headline: EditShare Updates at IBC Include EFS, Flow AI and MediaSilo
items.excerpt: EditShare brings GPU-powered Flow AI processing into its storage nodes at IBC 2026, with multilingual transcription expanding to 13 languages.

items.headline: Astro Burn Game Expands Into Animated Vertical Microseries
items.excerpt: HaZ Dulull and Nura Studios turn an indie game into ten one-minute vertical episodes, a case study in how AI-assisted production opens transmedia routes for small teams.

items.headline: Danny Boyle Voices Fears For Journalism & Speaking Truth To Power In Age Of AI As 'Ink' Debuts In Venice
items.excerpt: Premiering 'Ink' in Venice, Danny Boyle warned about what generative AI does to the making and trusting of images and reporting: 'It's insane what we're doing.'

items.headline: Crafty Apes CEO Alana Newell
items.excerpt: From compositor to CEO: Alana Newell on where Crafty Apes is heading as VFX pipelines absorb new tooling and studios rethink how shots get made.

items.headline: Congrats to the Engineering, Science & Technology Emmy Award Winners
items.excerpt: The Television Academy and NATAS named the 2026 Emmy Awards for engineering, science and technology, honouring the production tech that quietly reshapes how shows get finished.

items.headline: Over 500 Free Maya Animation Tools Are Now Available In One Place
items.excerpt: Animo v10.0 collects more than 500 free Maya animation tools into a single library, putting a large chunk of the animator's daily toolkit behind one install.

items.headline: Introducing Solaris, our first Interface World Model
items.excerpt: Runway unveils Solaris, an 'interface world model' that generates interactive interfaces frame by frame — a generative system aimed at software surfaces rather than shots.

items.headline: Full Metal Lunchbox | Runway
items.excerpt: A Runway-made short about broccoli gone AWOL — a showcase reel of what the current generation of the toolset can hold together across a full comedic narrative.

items.headline: Getting Started with Runway Ruby
items.excerpt: Runway Ruby generates or converts video into 16-bit EXR sequences and 10/12-bit ProRes — pushing generative output into formats a VFX and grading pipeline can actually ingest.

items.headline: What makes a good ROTOSCOPE?
items.excerpt: Emmy-nominated VFX supervisor Marion Spates breaks down what separates a good roto from a bad one — the craft judgement that automated matting tools still have to clear.

items.headline: Apple Can Now Clone You and it's CRAZY Realistic
items.excerpt: Curious Refuge tests Apple's new photoreal personal-avatar cloning and what that level of digital-double fidelity means for performers and AI filmmaking workflows.
